decision: The competitor (Alfa Romeo Sauber F1 Team) is fined €5,000.
event_name: Date 27 July 2018 Time 17:03 2018 HUNGARIAN GRAND PRIX 26 - 29 July The Stewards, having received a report from the Race Director, summoned (document 8) and heard from the team representative, have considered the following matter and hereby determine the following
fact: Car 9 was released from a pit stop in an unsafe condition.
offence: Breach of Article 28.13 (b) of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
reason: The Stewards reviewed the video of the pit stop of Car 9 at 16:07 and heard from the team representative. The Stewards determined that the car was released in an unsafe condition in breach of Art. 28.13(b) as the wheel was not properly attached to the car when released. The team reacted instantly, instructing the driver to stop the car and the driver stopped the car in a safe manner immediately. Consistent with previous decisions of a similar nature, the Stewards decided that the grid place penalty mentioned in the above Article would not be applied as the driver took all appropriate actions at the first available opportunity. Accordingly, the Stewards fined the team €5,000.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
title: Doc 10 2018 Hungarian Grand Prix Offence Sauber Release Of A Car In An Unsafe Condition
